items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It sounds almost like Indian and counting Tal and…

ctx.x: I was involved with The Creative Music Studio. The Creative Music Studio is something that was created by Karl Berger. He was from Germany and Karl and his wife Ingrid Sertso… They formed The Creative Music Studio. Karl has a long history of being an innovator vibist and composer. He has this way of teaching rhythm called Gamela Taki. Teaching people their rhythms [sings an example].
It sounds almost like Indian and counting Tal and…

Yeah, it’s very interesting. I was involved with a lot of people… First Karl had a small place and then it kind of legendarily grew, and people started coming to it, and they moved the facility to a lodge in the area here. It was better set up so that you could have students come for workshops and classes. In that period we got a chance to meet a lot of world renowned musicians, Don Cherry, Trilok Gurtu, the percussionist
